note: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is [age-standardized](#dod:age_standardized).
title: Share of people with an eating disorder, women vs. men
subtitle: Estimated share of women and men who have [an eating disorder](#dod:eating_disorder), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. This only includes anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa. Prevalence is measured as the share experiencing an eating disorder at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
